messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired: INC-45321 - embedders-eu high latency (P2) - avg p95 1.1s -> page routed to on-call
pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-45321 has been routed to leo-oncall (ack timeout 30m)
leo-oncall: acked, i'm taking this. beginning triage.
sam: saw spike in 5xx/latency on embeddings write path around 14:02 UTC, sampling logs now
maria: customer-support: multiple customers seeing 503s for embed requests, tagging support-ticket-queue. will collect customer IDs
leo-oncall: quick check: autoscaler did a scale-down ~13:55 UTC for embedders-eu. possible cold-cache + warmup. pulling node logs and metrics
aj: can we failover critical traffic to us region temporarily? cost ok for 30m if needed
leo-oncall: thinking: first try pool restart and rate-limit lower-priority traffic. failover if latency doesn't improve in 10m.
sam: logs show repeated OOMKill on embed-worker-7:
```
Jun 03 13:56:22 embed-worker-7 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4321 (python) score 987
Jun 03 13:56:22 kubelet: Pod embedder-7 restarted due to OOMKilled
```
leo-oncall: restarting affected pool nodes now (rolling restart small windows). running: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/embedders-eu -n prod`
tom: infra: holding scale-down for embedders-eu for 30m, set min-replicas=3
incident-bot: Auto-remediation: restarted pod embedder-7, triggered by policy restart-on-oom
pagerduty: INC-45321 acknowledged by leo-oncall (ack at 2967001250)
leo-oncall: node restarts complete, latencies trending down p95 -> 420ms. KV cache miss rate still elevated (25% -> 18%)
sam: looks like restart helped but warmup needed. QPS normalizing.
maria: customer-support update: opened ticket for top 3 affected customers, advising degraded performance and mitigation steps.
aj: thanks. enabling route fallback for tier-1 to us for safe margin now (will monitor)
leo-oncall: enabled fallback policy for routes with url match /v1/embeddings (tier:critical). monitoring heatmap
incident-bot: Automated monitor: error-rate decreased to baseline over last 5m, continuing to monitor
leo-oncall: continuing to watch for 15m, if stable will set incident to mitigated and handback to owners for postmortem
tom: infra: reverted autoscaler policy change to prevent immediate scale-down for 10m :thumbsup:
sam: note for postmortem: investigate oom thresholds + bump reserved mem for worker image, and cache prewarm on scale-up
maria: prepping customer comms draft, will share in #support for review
leo-oncall: setting follow-up runbook and assigning postmortem to eng-runtime. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-oncall.
incident-bot: Incident INC-45321 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Mitigation started at 2967001330, status updated at 2967002434
leo-oncall: thanks everyone — leaving a few ownership tasks and moving to post-incident. :white_check_mark:
